code: Welcome to the vault. Eleven places to keep what matters - walk me around and we'll find them.
WASD, arrows or a tap on the floor. Stand near a place and press Enter, or tap me.
The round door stands open. It's a place to remember, not a lock.
The round door wants a code. Four digits - the year the vault was built.
It opens. Inside: nothing but room. Put what matters here.
Someone's calling on the Comms Desk. Let's put them on the big screen.
Hi! I'm a Live2D model - Cubism 5, drawn live in WebGL. Move your pointer and I'll look at it.
I can play motions on cue, blink, breathe, and move my mouth with a voice line.
That's all from me. Back to the vault!
